objects.name: Analytic 1670
objects.description: For iOS, detect Drive-By Compromise by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Network Connection Creation via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [com.apple.WebKit or com.apple.WebContent process fault at level=fault within $DriveByWindow$ of navigation to flagged URL — kernel fault in WebKit subsystem is the exploit-execution signal]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
